605:t_014:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come back, $$バナージ$$. You're no illusion, and you don't exist only as a consciousness.」

605:t_014:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You still have a place to come home to.」

605:t_014:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「How are you going to hold $$ミネバ$$ like that?! I'll steal $$オードリー$$ from you, $$バナージ$$!!」

605:t_014:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come to see you... I will...」

605:t_014:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's right. You have to come back.」

605:t_015:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「GN particles... are filling this sector of space.」

605:t_015:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Now our hearts will connect with $$バナージ$$.」

605:t_015:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Come back, $$バナージ$$. You're no illusion, and you don't exist only as a consciousness.」

605:t_015:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You still have a place to come home to.」

605:t_015:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「How are you going to hold $$ミネバ$$ like that?! I'll steal $$オードリー$$ from you, $$バナージ$$!!」

605:t_015:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll come to see you... I will...」

605:t_016:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let's take our time thinking about what to do with her.」

605:t_016:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Check our surroundings. If there are no enemy readings, order all units to return...」

605:t_016:7.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Please wait! $$ヴェーダ$$ hasn't shut down the system yet!」

605:t_016:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Now $$ヴェーダ$$ is going to transmit something to the entire world!」

605:t_016:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The truth at the very heart of $$ラプラスの箱$$...」

605:t_016:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$クロノ$$'s doctrine... Has the time come for it to be revealed...?」

605:t_016:13.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I am not the one who will tell it.」

605:t_016:15.en:
$$フェルト$$
「This is... $$エルガン・ローディック$$!」

605:t_017:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Humanity must not be allowed to evolve... That is $$クロノ$$'s doctrine...!」

605:t_017:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Our history... the history of every parallel world has been shaped by $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_017:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Humanity first went to the Moon hundreds of years ago!」

605:t_017:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Humanity has been watched ever since... By $$クロノ$$... by $$サイデリアル$$...!」

605:t_017:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So this is what $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#pilot$$ meant about the Moon!」

605:t_017:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Even $$ジオン・ダイクン$$'s assassination was engineered by $$サイデリアル$$...」

605:t_017:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「Are you saying even the $$ザビ家$$ was merely being manipulated...?」

605:t_017:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「The fighting between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s was all caused by $$クロノ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$ too...」

605:t_017:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So the same goes for the three major powers and $$ＯＺ$$...」

605:t_017:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「To think they've been doing that...! Just how much power does $$サイデリアル$$ have?!」

605:t_017:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「A-are we... fighting people like that?!」

605:t_017:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「The fundamental calamity... I can feel it when I look at those black $$アンゲロイ$$s and those crystal monsters...」

605:t_017:12.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Can we... really win...? Against them...」

605:t_017:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Is this sense of despair what $$フル・フロンタル$$ meant by closing off possibility...?」

605:t_017:14.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now I understand... If humanity continues as a species, it will inevitably have to fight $$サイデリアル$$... the fundamental calamity...」

605:t_017:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is that fact itself the despairing future...?!」

605:t_017:16.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「$$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$ tried to bring about the appearance of $$イノベイター$$s as beings who could overcome it...」

605:t_017:17.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「And $$エルガン・ローディック$$ formed $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ as a force to fight it.」

605:t_017:18.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$... Did you know of them... of $$ＡＤＷ$$, even before the $$大時空震動$$?」

605:t_017:19.en:
$$サイアム$$
「When $$エルガン・ローディック$$ visited me, I learned of parallel worlds and the despairing future...」

605:t_017:20.en:
$$サイアム$$
「And just after the $$ラプラス事件$$, I saw someone smiling sadly amid the light of the explosion... That convinced me humanity's overseers existed.」

605:t_017:21.en:
$$サイアム$$
「I was like $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$... I waited for beings who could one day break that prison...」

605:t_017:22.en:
$$サイアム$$
「And that wish has come true...」

605:t_017:23.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying we... $c... are that power...?」

605:t_018:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$... You're here too.」

605:t_018:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「After learning this truth, $$リディ・マーセナス$$ once sank into the depths of despair.」

605:t_018:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「It's true... When I was adrift in space, that man saved me and told me about the overseers.」

605:t_018:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「So what do you want with us?」

605:t_018:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Are you going to tell us to help you purge $$クロノ$$, $$サイデリアル$$'s dogs, as Reformists?」

605:t_018:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Or did you come to see how shocked we are?」

605:t_018:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is up to you too.」

605:t_018:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Before that, let us welcome them.」

605:t_019:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「It seems they're quite unhappy that we learned $$クロノ$$'s doctrine.」

605:t_019:2.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Don't flatter yourselves, Earthlings.」

605:t_019:4.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$'s top man has come in person?!」

605:t_019:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Welcome, Emperor $$アウストラリス$$. Now all twelve $$スフィア$$s are gathered here.」

605:t_019:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Yes... He is the $$立ち上がる射手$$'s Reactor.」
